'''Sabo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] who served as a member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was captain of a [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class attack shuttle]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Sabo was one of the pirates that was given an offer by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to serve them in their conquest for power and takeover of [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Sabo refused to betray Ohnaka and serve the brothers and was [[Shiak|killed]] by Maul while Maul and Ohnaka were communicating by [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] used the execution to emphasize his warning to Ohnaka that there was a [[Death/Legends|penalty]] for those that refused to serve him.

==Personality and traits==
Sabo was loyal despite being a pirate, refusing to join Maul and Opress when he still worked for Ohnaka, a choice that he ended up paying for with his life.

==Behind the scenes==
Sabo is voiced by [[Tom Kane]] in the [[Revival (episode)|first episode]] of [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]].
